triage.kind_span: 8,528,621 Shares of Common Stock Issuable Upon Exercise of Rights to Subscribe for Such Shares

subject_names.span: accompanied by the prospectus of the Liberty All-Star Growth Fund, Inc. (the “Fund”) dated May 24, 2021

subject_tickers.span: The Fund’s common shares are currently listed, and the new common shares issued in this Offer will also be listed on the NYSE under the symbol “ASG”.

security_class.span: 8,528,621 Shares of Common Stock Issuable Upon Exercise of Rights to Subscribe for Such Shares

rights_per_share.span: Record Date Shareholders will receive one Right for each common share held on the Record Date. For every five Rights held, you are entitled to purchase one new common share of the Fund.

rights_per_new_share.span: For every five Rights held, you are entitled to purchase one new common share of the Fund.

price_reference.span: The Subscription Price will be 95% of the lower of (i) the average of the last reported sales prices of a share on the NYSE on June 28, 2021 and the four days preceding the Expiration Date, or (ii) the NAV of a share on the Expiration Date.

price_pct.span: The Subscription Price will be 95% of the lower of (i) the average of the last reported sales prices of a share on the NYSE on June 28, 2021 and the four days preceding the Expiration Date, or (ii) the NAV of a share on the Expiration Date.

record_date.span: The Fund is issuing Rights to its common shareholders of record as of May 24, 2021 (the “Record Date” and such shareholders, “Record Date Shareholders”).

expiration_date.span: The Offer will expire at 5:00 p.m., Eastern Time, on June 28, 2021, unless the Offer is extended as described in this Prospectus (the “Expiration Date”).

transferable.span: The Rights are non-transferable and will not be admitted for trading on the NYSE.

over_subscription.span: Record Date Shareholders who fully exercise their Rights may also, in certain circumstances, purchase additional common shares pursuant to an over-subscription privilege.

max_new_shares.span: These Rights will allow Record Date Shareholders to subscribe for new shares of common stock of the Fund (“common shares”) in an aggregate amount of approximately 8,528,621 common shares (the “Offer”).

notes: Form 424B1 final prospectus dated May 24, 2021 (not a supplement). Subscription price = 95% of the lower of (i) the average last reported sales price on the Expiration Date and the four preceding trading days, or (ii) NAV on the Expiration Date; no NAV floor stated. The Important Dates table lists a separate Pricing Date of June 29, 2021 (the day after the June 28, 2021 Expiration Date). max_new_shares (approximately 8,528,621) excludes the secondary over-subscription, which the Fund may add in an amount up to 25% of the shares issued in the primary subscription. Fund states it is a diversified closed-end management investment company; this is its sixth rights offering. Rights are non-transferable and not listed. Expiration date stated once (unless extended).
